title: Semantic token tagging and lifecycle telemetry for per-scope keys
creator: Marcus Nguyen
description:
Problem: Our current token surface (service keys, ephemeral per-scope tokens, and long-lived admin keys) lacks consistent metadata and observability. Operations and SRE teams struggle to triage suspicious usage and roll out targeted rotations because tokens do not carry provable semantic information and our telemetry doesn't expose lifecycle events. This increases blast radius during incidents and slows down automated remediation workflows.

Goal: Add a small, backward-compatible token metadata + telemetry layer that: (1) standardizes a semantic tagging scheme embedded in token identifiers and token metadata, (2) attaches lifecycle telemetry events (mint, renew, rotate, retire, revoke, "usage-anomaly") to audit logs and our metrics pipeline, and (3) exposes admin console controls and APIs to query/tag/filter tokens by semantic attributes.

Approach:
- Token naming convention: introduce a stable, URL-safe token label format: <issuer>~<scope>~<env>~<short-hash>~<ttl-suffix>. The label is surface-only (not secret) and lives in token metadata (persisted in token ledger). Examples: "svc-payments~read-only~prod~4f2b~30d" or "sdk-web~user-scoped~staging~9c1d~ephemeral". This avoids leaking secrets while giving operators intent and owner info at a glance.
- Semantic tags: allow an arbitrary set of tags (max 8) on creation: role, owner-team, project, risk-level, rotation-policy. Tags are indexed for fast search in console and can be used as selectors in policy/routing rules.
- Lifecycle telemetry: emit structured audit events for mint/renew/rotate/retire/revoke and a separate "usage-anomaly" event when thresholds (geo, rate, token-typo, sudden-surge) fire. Events include token_label, token_id (hashed), actor, scope, policy_ref, and optional link to correlated trace. Events are written to audit log and to telemetry system (Kafka topic: token-lifecycle.v1).
- Backfill and migration: create a migration job to scan existing tokens and synthesize token_label using best-effort heuristics (owner/service from metadata, environment from creation context). Backfilled labels are annotated with "_synth" tag and exposed in console as "Suggested label" until owner confirms.
- Policies and automation: support tag-based automated rotation policies (e.g., rotate tokens with risk-level=high every 7d). Integrate with existing rotation worker; add a pre-check that can gracefully nudge dependent services via rollout flags.
- Console & API changes: add token search by label/tags, token timeline (events), and bulk rotate/retire workflows. Admin APIs accept tags and return lists keyed by tag selectors. All new endpoints are gated behind feature flag "token-semantic-tags" for staged rollout.

Security & privacy notes: token_label must not contain secrets (no email addresses, no raw service secrets). Enforce validation at server and SDK levels. Audit events should use token_id hashed with HMAC using a rotating key so that logs are searchable without storing raw tokens.

Success criteria: faster incident triage (target median time-to-identify token owner reduced by 50% in pilot teams), ability to run tag-based rotations with zero-authored-downtime for non-admin tokens, and no P0 regressions or audit log gaps after rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Token metadata schema accepts token_label and tags on mint; validation enforced in API and SDKs
Audit events emitted for mint/renew/rotate/retire/revoke and injected into token-lifecycle.v1 Kafka topic
Console search/filter UI shows labels and tags; token timeline available for tokens in pilot orgs
Backfill job synthesizes labels for existing tokens and marks suggestions; owners can confirm/update labels via console
Tag-based rotation policies can be created and executed by rotation worker with observable audit trail
Feature gated behind 'token-semantic-tags' flag with a staged rollout plan and rollback documented
tasks: Design token_label format and validation regex
Schema migration: add label/tags columns + index to token ledger
Emit structured lifecycle events from token service (produce to Kafka)
Implement backfill job and UI for suggested labels
Console: add search/filter, token timeline, and bulk rotate UI
SDK: helper to generate recommended token_label during create flows
E2E tests: telemetry ingestion, console rendering, rotation worker integration
Run canary with two pilot orgs and measure triage times
comments: 2026-03-08 Marcus Nguyen: Created ticket after post-incident review where ops couldn't identify holder of an abused token. Linked the incident runbook and initial spike notes in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SEC/Token+Tagging+Spike

2026-03-09 Ariana Patel: Design feedback - prefer tags over embedding owner emails in labels. Suggest 'risk-level' and 'rotation-policy' as first-class tags. Also: ensure label length limit 128 bytes. Added to tasks.

2026-03-10 Security (Leila Soto): Reviewed privacy implications. Approved label format provided we block PII at validator and add HMAC hashing for token_id in logs. Requested explicit test coverage for audit log retention and rotatable hash key handling.

2026-03-11 Charlie Kim (SRE): Prototype of Kafka event producer done (branch: feat/token-telemetry). Observed increased QPS to token-service metric ingestion; added rate-limiting to telemetry producer. Filed ENG-72112 for telemetry throttling work.

2026-03-12 Ariana Patel: Implemented server-side validation and initial migration SQL in draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/token-service/pull/12345. Marking 'In Progress'. Planning canary for two pilot orgs (payments-team, search-platform) next week.
